post.summary: Searches movies by free text with catalog filters. Movie texts in the Accept-Language locale.

get.summary: Movies nearest to this one by embedding (cosine similarity), best first. Empty while the movie has no vector.
Movies the owner bought or currently rents, one entry per movie. Titles in the Accept-Language locale.
Paged movie list with filters and sorting. Texts in the Accept-Language locale.
Movie details with genres, credits and offers. Texts in the Accept-Language locale.
Genres with names in the Accept-Language locale.
The owner's cart with current prices from the catalog. Titles in the Accept-Language locale.

post.summary: Adds a movie's buy or rent offer; replaces another offer of the same movie.

delete.summary: Removes a movie from the cart.

post.summary: Creates a pending order from the cart with a price snapshot. Requires the Idempotency-Key header; a repeated key returns the same order.

get.summary: Order details with status. The success page polls it until the webhook marks the order paid.

post.summary: Creates a payment session and returns the hosted page URL. Idempotent while the session is open; after a failed payment it starts a new attempt.
Starts a conversation with the assistant. The body is optional.

get.summary: The owner's conversations, most recently updated first (at most 50).
A conversation with its user messages and answers; movie cards with current prices in the Accept-Language locale.

post.summary: Sends a message and streams the answer as server-sent events: message.started, message.delta, tool.started, tool.completed, movies, cart.updated, confirmation.required, message.completed or error (spec 04).
The user's answer to a confirmation.required event. Approved: creates the order from the unchanged cart and the payment session and returns checkoutUrl; the model alone can never do this.
Rates an answer with thumbs up (1) or down (-1); a new rating replaces the old one.
Loads the seed file into the catalog. Idempotent: upsert by TMDB id.
Sends one message to a chat profile (default: the active one) and returns the answer with token usage.

get.summary: Active embedding model, stored vectors per model and locale, and the current or last reindex job.

delete.summary: Deletes all vectors of a model that is not the active one.

post.summary: Starts a background reindex job (202). 409 while another job is queued or running.

profile.description: Chat profile name from `AI:ChatProfiles`; the active profile when empty.

AdminAiChatResponse.description: Answer of a chat profile with token usage and estimated cost (null when the model has no price).

profile.description: Embedding profile from `AI:EmbeddingProfiles`; the active one when empty.

onlyStale.description: Embed only movies whose embedding text changed (default). False re-embeds every movie.

locales.description: Locales to keep vectors for (`en`, `ru`, `sv`); `Search:Embeddings:Locales` when empty. Vectors of other locales of this model are deleted.

AssistantEvent.description: An event of an assistant turn. The JSON data carries the event name as `type` (a discriminated union in the OpenAPI document).

AssistantEventCartUpdatedEvent.description: The cart changed through a tool (I12).

AssistantEventConfirmationRequiredEvent.description: The assistant asks the user to confirm an action (checkout, I12). Nothing is paid until the user confirms through the confirmations endpoint before ExpiresAt.

AssistantEventErrorEvent.description: The turn failed; the stream ends. Code is one of AssistantErrorCodes.

AssistantEventMessageCompletedEvent.description: The answer is complete and stored.

AssistantEventMessageDeltaEvent.description: The next chunk of the answer text (markdown).

AssistantEventMessageStartedEvent.description: The answer was started; MessageId is the id of the stored answer (for feedback).

AssistantEventMoviesEvent.description: Movie cards to show next to the answer, built from tool results (catalog data), not from model text.

AssistantEventToolCompletedEvent.description: A tool call finished; Ok is false when the tool refused the arguments or failed.

AssistantEventToolStartedEvent.description: A tool call started; the UI shows e.g. "Searching the catalog…".

CartItemSource.description: Who put a line into the cart.

priceMinor.description: Current price of the offer in minor units.

addedAt.description: When the line was added or changed.

available.description: False when the offer is no longer sold; such lines are not in the total and block the order.

totalMinor.description: Sum of the available lines in minor units.

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted payment page to redirect the browser to.

expiresAt.description: The session and the unpaid order expire at this time.

approved.description: true: go to payment; false: decline.

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted payment page to redirect the browser to (approved only).

expiresAt.description: The payment session and the unpaid order expire at this time (approved only).

ConfirmationResult.description: Result of the user's answer to a confirmation.

ConfirmationStatus.description: State of a confirmation. ConfirmationStatus.Expired is never stored: a pending confirmation past its expiry time is shown as expired.

ConfirmationSummary.description: What the user confirms: the cart lines and the total computed by the server.

messageId.description: The answer the confirmation belongs to.

status.description: pending, approved, declined, superseded (a newer one was requested) or expired.

summary.description: What the user confirms: cart lines and the total computed by the server.

expiresAt.description: The user can confirm until this time.

ConfirmationView.description: A confirmation the assistant asked for.

title.description: Beginning of the first user message; null before it.
Beginning of the first user message.

usage.description: Tokens and estimated cost of the whole conversation (answers and summaries).

ConversationView.description: A conversation with its visible messages (user messages and answers; tool rounds are left out).

locale.description: Locale of movie texts when a message request has no Accept-Language header: en, ru or sv. Default: the request locale.

EmbeddingIndexState.description: State of the embedding index: the active model and the stored vectors of every model.

EmbeddingJobStatus.description: State of a background reindex job. `Progress` while it runs, `Result` when it succeeded, `Error` when it failed.

EmbeddingSetStats.description: Number of stored vectors of one model and locale.

validUntil.description: End of a rental; null for owned movies.

movies.description: Movie cards of an answer, built from the catalog now (current prices).

promptVersion.description: System prompt id of the answer.

oneOf.description: Tokens and estimated cost of the answer.

latencyMs.description: Time to the end of the answer.

oneOf.description: The owner's rating of the answer.
The latest confirmation the answer asked for (checkout button), with its current status.

MessageView.description: A user message or an answer of the assistant.

posterPath.description: TMDB poster path; the UI builds the image URL.

genres.description: Genre names in the request locale.

reason.description: Why the movie fits the request (reserved; not filled yet).

MovieCard.description: A movie shown next to an assistant message. Built from the catalog (prices from the DB), never from model text (FR-AST-3).

title.description: Title when the order was created.

priceMinor.description: Price when the order was created, in minor units.

OrderStatus.description: State of an order (spec 03 §2). Changes only through methods of Order.

expiresAt.description: An unpaid order expires at this time.

paidAt.description: When the payment was confirmed by the provider webhook.

items.description: Order lines with the price snapshot.

ReindexProgress.description: Progress of a reindex: `Processed` of `Total` movie texts (movies × locales) checked so far.

ReindexRequest.description: What to (re)embed. `Profile`: embedding profile, the active one when null. `OnlyStale`: embed only movies whose text hash changed; false re-embeds everything. `Locales`: locales to keep vectors for, the configured ones when null; vectors of other locales of this model are deleted.

ReindexResult.description: Outcome of a reindex. `Deleted`: vectors of this model for locales that are no longer indexed.

keywordScore.description: `ts_rank_cd` over the best-matching text search config, normalized to 0–1.

keywordMatch.description: `all`: every query term matched (`websearch_to_tsquery`). `any`: no movie matched all terms, so the query was relaxed to match any term.

SearchDebug.description: Retrieval details of one item (spec 05 §4). Fields of retrievers that did not run are null. Ranks start at 1 and are positions in that retriever's list.

genres.description: Genre slugs; a movie matches any of them.

excludeGenres.description: Genre slugs the movie must not have.

SearchFilters.description: Catalog filters in a JSON body (FR-SRCH-5). Same meaning and limits as the `GET /api/movies` query.

movie.description: The movie in the requested locale.

score.description: Score of the mode that produced the list: keyword rank score, similarity or fused score. Higher is better.

query.description: Free text in English, Russian or Swedish.

oneOf.description: The same filters as `GET /api/movies`, applied inside the search query.

understand.description: Turn the free text into filters and a search text with the LLM first (FR-SRCH-4); explicit filters win over found ones.

SearchRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/search` (spec 04 "Search"). Validated at the boundary; invalid input → 400 Problem Details.

appliedFilters.description: The filters the search used, normalized: the request's filters merged with the ones found by query understanding.

total.description: Number of matching movies (keyword), or length of the result list (semantic: at most 100; hybrid: union of the fused candidate lists).

oneOf.description: Result of query understanding when `understand` was true.

degraded.description: Hybrid search returned keyword results only because the query could not be embedded.

TokenUsage.description: Tokens of all model calls of a turn.

genresInclude.description: Genre slugs the movie should have (any of them).

genresExclude.description: Genre slugs the movie must not have.

UnderstoodFilters.description: Filters found by query understanding. Null or empty means "not mentioned".

semanticQuery.description: What to search for, without the parts that became filters (English).

similarToTitles.description: Titles from "movies like X"; resolved to catalog movies by keyword search.

detectedLocale.description: Language of the query (`en`, `ru`, `sv`) when the model recognized it.

promptVersion.description: Prompt that produced the result, e.g. `query-understanding.v1`.

error.description: Why the result is a fallback (validation or provider error), for debugging.

UnderstoodQuery.description: Result of query understanding: the text to search for, the filters found in the query and the titles of movies the user wants something similar to.

estimatedCostUsd.description: Estimated cost in USD; 0 for models without a price.
